title: Business Phrasal Verbs
completion_message: ¡Magnífico! Los phrasal verbs te harán sonar mucho más natural en el entorno corporativo.

stages.title: Phrasal Verbs Comunes en los Negocios

parts.visual:
Call off (Cancelar). Ej: We called off the meeting (Cancelamos la reunión). 
Set up (Configurar / Organizar). Ej: Let's set up a meeting (Organicemos una reunión).
parts.audio: Call off means to cancel. For example: We called off the meeting. Set up means to arrange or organize. For example: Let's set up a meeting.

parts.visual:
Figure out (Averiguar / Resolver). Ej: We need to figure out the problem. 
Back up (Respaldar / Apoyar). Ej: Back up your files! 
Look forward to (Esperar con ansias). Ej: I look forward to working with you.
parts.audio: Figure out means to solve or understand something. Back up means to support or make a copy of files. Look forward to means you are excited about something in the future.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el Phrasal Verb correcto según el contexto.

questions.question: The manager is sick, so we have to ____ the meeting. (Cancelar).
I need to ____ a meeting with the client for tomorrow. (Organizar/Programar).
questions.explanation: Set up = organizar / preparar (una reunión, un equipo).

questions.question: The system is broken. We need to ____ how to fix it. (Averiguar/Resolver).
questions.explanation: Figure out = averiguar, entender cómo resolver un problema.

questions.question: Always remember to ____ your important files. (Respaldar).
questions.explanation: Back up = respaldar (hacer copia de seguridad) o apoyar a alguien.

questions.question: I look ____ to our next meeting. (Espero con ansias/Quedo a la espera).
questions.explanation: Look forward to = esperar algo con entusiasmo o formalidad (al final de los correos).

questions.question: Please ____ this form with your personal details. (Llenar).
questions.explanation: Fill out = completar o llenar (un formulario).

questions.question: We are running ____ of paper. We need to buy more. (Quedándonos sin).
questions.explanation: Run out of = quedarse sin algo (run out of paper, time, money).

questions.question: I need to ____ this problem before tomorrow. (Resolver / Lidiar con).
questions.explanation: Deal with = lidiar con / encargarse de (un problema, cliente).

questions.question: Can you ____ the new project? (Hacerte cargo/Tomar el control).
questions.explanation: Take over = tomar el control o asumir la responsabilidad de algo.

questions.question: The meeting was ____ because of the strike. (Cancelada - Pasado).
questions.explanation: Pasado de call off = called off (cancelada).

questions.question: IT is coming to ____ my new computer. (Configurar).
questions.explanation: Set up también significa instalar o configurar equipo.

questions.question: I will ____ my team in the presentation. (Apoyar/Respaldar).
questions.explanation: Back up también significa apoyar a alguien.

questions.question: I look forward ____ hearing from you. (A tener noticias tuyas).
questions.explanation: La expresión completa es 'Look forward TO' (y el verbo que sigue va con -ing).

questions.question: We need to ____ an alternative plan. (Idear/Proponer).
questions.explanation: Come up with = proponer / inventar (una idea, plan).

questions.question: Sales ____ significantly last quarter. (Aumentaron/Subieron).
questions.explanation: Go up (pasado went up) = subir / aumentar.

questions.question: Profits ____ due to the crisis. (Bajaron/Cayeron).
questions.explanation: Go down (pasado went down) = bajar / disminuir.

questions.question: I will ____ the details in the email. (Revisar/Examinar).
Don't ____! You can do this! (Rendirse).
questions.explanation: Give up = rendirse / darse por vencido.

questions.question: Could you ____ on the line, please? (Esperar en el teléfono).
questions.explanation: Hold on = esperar (especialmente en el teléfono).

questions.question: We ____ of time in the meeting. (Nos quedamos sin).
questions.explanation: Pasado de run out (quedarse sin) = ran out.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la preposición correcta (off, up, out, with) o el verbo para completar el phrasal verb.

questions.question: We had to call ____ the meeting. (Cancelar)
Let's set ____ a meeting. (Organizar)
We must figure ____ a solution. (Averiguar)
Please back ____ your files. (Respaldar)
Please fill ____ this form. (Completar)
We ran ____ of money. (Nos quedamos sin)
I look ____ to seeing you. (Espero con ansias)
We need to deal ____ this issue. (Lidiar)
Sales went ____. (Aumentaron/Subieron)
Let's go ____ the report. (Revisar)
